sections.description: AI-powered CSS/JS asset scanner for WordPress.
sections.changelog: Version 1.7.91b (beta): fixed a layout issue where the "Measure Your Gains" sidebar could overlap the Step-4 results table. A row with a long URL plus a long "Needs Extra Time" annotation could exceed the results column's width and spill onto the adjacent sidebar box, covering the Extra Time checkbox. The results list now scrolls horizontally instead of overflowing onto the sidebar.
